name: Sorazome
source:
Freshman Mayumi is forced to join Psychological Phenomena Research Department by a mysterious boy Yukino who pretends to be a school student. He is trying to find out the truth about his sister's suicide, and the truth is hidden in this school...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
新生真由美被假扮成学生的神秘少年雪野强迫加入心理现象研究部。他正试图找出妹妹自杀的真相，而真相就隐藏在这所学校里……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
